Several of these proposed release practices have counterparts in the
records described here~\cite[Section 2.B, Step I]{agmai2026}: the short
paper and long record explain and attribute the argument, the paper-to-Lean
ledger records formal correspondence and its limits, and the challenge
files and generated \texttt{formalization.yaml} expose the comparison inputs.
Those records make the result inspectable; they do not certify a
mathematician's understanding. The architecture alone does not establish
complete per-result model, prompt, time and cost disclosure, an account of
campaign-wide selection and unsuccessful attempts, or an independent
scholarly deposit. The further recommendations on funding community-led
understanding and equitable model access address AI laboratories; this
prototype does not demonstrate those institutional outcomes.
